_meta.do_not_edit: Edit the source MD file; CI regenerates this dist file.

parts.name: Backdrop or scrim
parts.description: modal-only dim layer that blocks the page beneath; drawers may use a partial scrim

parts.name: Container
parts.description: the overlay surface itself; carries elevation, radius, and motion origin

parts.name: Header
parts.description: title plus close affordance; required for modals and drawers, optional for popovers

parts.name: Body content
parts.description: the overlay payload; rich content for modals/drawers, short content for popovers/tooltips

parts.name: Footer (optional)
parts.description: primary and secondary actions for modals and drawers

parts.name: Arrow or pointer (popover/tooltip only)
parts.description: connects the overlay to its anchor

patterns.note: modals enter with a scrim fade plus container scale-up from center; exit reverses; timing from motion foundations
drawers slide in from the anchored edge with easing; the scrim fades in parallel
popovers and tooltips animate from their trigger anchor; the arrow stays attached to the anchor through entry and exit

requirements.title: Focus trap
requirements.body: modals and drawers trap focus inside the container while open; Tab and Shift+Tab cycle within the overlay

requirements.title: Focus restore on close
requirements.body: on dismiss, focus returns to the trigger that opened the overlay; if the trigger is gone, focus moves to a sensible fallback

requirements.title: Escape to dismiss
requirements.body: Escape closes dismissible overlays; required-action modals (e.g., confirm destructive) opt out and announce why

requirements.title: Accessible name
requirements.body: the overlay container references its title via `aria-labelledby`; descriptive body content uses `aria-describedby` when needed

requirements.title: Backdrop click behavior consistency
requirements.body: backdrop-click dismissal is consistent across overlays of the same dismissibility variant; never dismiss required-action overlays via backdrop click

requirements.title: Role assignment
requirements.body: modals and drawers use `role="dialog"` with `aria-modal="true"`; tooltips use `role="tooltip"`; popovers use the appropriate ARIA pattern for their content
